note: Reviewed regression contracts of the 194 -> 214 hop, read by
scripts/verify_214_custom_hunks.py. A contract states something the hunk
shape and literal comparison cannot see: an absence (a relocated row left
no residue), a cross-file pairing (the probe script is wrapped by the same
method that builds it), a declaration that has to stay unique, a resource
id that has to be reachable by name, or a constant set that is the feature.
Every anchor is written in 194 terms - the class, the member, the field and
the needle as the reviewed 194 tree spells them - and the verifier resolves
class-map-review.json), preferring the reviewed member map and falling back
to the parameter shape inside the mapped class. Registers are matched by
shape, never by number, because the frame a release hands the customization
is a property of that release. Only where the map cannot name an owner - an
R8 facade dissolved into its caller - does a contract carry a reviewed
